changed.item: The original proposes replacing Hearth & Wick's 'polystyrene packaging'. The edit narrows this to 'your polystyrene inserts', which assumes the polystyrene is specifically inserts.

'We can supply 5,000 units a month' became 'We can make 5000 a month for Hearth & Wick'. The claim shifts from supply capacity to production capacity and implies the units are dedicated to Hearth & Wick.
'Samples are free' (a plain fact) became 'would love to send some over for you to test for free'. This is a softer offer, but the substance is the same.

added.item: Product claims that the inserts are 'sustainable, high quality and beautiful'. These are qualitative selling claims that aren't in the original.
An explanation that the inserts are 'made from mushroom (Mycelium)'. This is a slightly loose gloss, since mycelium is the root network of fungi, not the mushroom itself.
A redundant second greeting, 'Hi there!', after 'Hi Priya,'.
